schemes.description: Schemes to build; every target they build is scanned.

index_exclude.description: Source file globs to leave out of indexing, added to the default ones.

report_exclude.description: Source file globs to leave out of the results, optionally per result kind with '<glob>:kind1,kind2' or {path, kinds}; the files are still indexed.

report_include.description: Source file globs to keep in the results; supersedes report_exclude; the other files are still indexed.

retain_public.description: Retain all public declarations, recommended for framework and library projects.

no_retain_spi.description: Public SPIs to analyze even when retain_public is enabled.

retain_files.description: Source file globs for which all containing declarations are retained.

retain_assign_only_properties.description: Retain properties that are assigned but never read.

retain_assign_only_property_types.description: Property types to retain when assigned but never read.

enable_unassigned_optional_analysis.description: Find optional properties that are read but never assigned (always nil).

retain_objc_accessible.description: Retain declarations exposed to Objective-C, implicitly (NSObject subclasses) or with @objc / @objcMembers.

retain_js_accessible.description: Retain protocols that inherit JSExport, their members and the members of conforming types that satisfy them.

retain_objc_annotated.description: Retain declarations exposed to Objective-C with @objc / @objcMembers only.

retain_unused_protocol_func_params.description: Retain unused protocol function parameters, even if unused in all conforming functions.

retain_unused_parameters_without_default.description: Retain unused function parameters that have no default value.

disable_redundant_public_analysis.description: Disable identification of redundant public accessibility.

enable_redundant_public_members.description: Also find redundant public accessibility on the members of public types and extensions.

enable_open_final_analysis.description: Find redundant open accessibility and classes or members that could be final.

enable_empty_extension_analysis.description: Find extensions that declare no member and no conformance.

enable_redundant_access_level_analysis.description: Find access modifiers identical to the default of their enclosing context.

report_unused_type_parameters.description: Also report unused generic parameters of types, ignored by default as they may be phantom types.

disable_platform_conditional_retention.description: Do not retain declarations unavailable on a platform or referenced from platform conditional compilation blocks.

disable_unused_import_analysis.description: Turn off the analysis of unused imports.

enable_unused_system_imports.description: Also analyze imports of system frameworks (experimental).

disable_unused_localized_string_analysis.description: Turn off the analysis of unused String Catalog (xcstrings) keys.

localized_string_catalog_exclude.description: String Catalog globs left out of the localized strings analysis.

localized_string_key_patterns.description: Key patterns (globs, or regular expressions between slashes) of keys used dynamically, retained from String Catalogs.

localized_string_key_literal_match.description: Retain localized string keys equal to any string literal of the source.

retain_runtime_localized_keys.description: Retain every key that a localized string key built at runtime without a literal prefix may look up.

superfluous_ignore_comments.description: Report ignore comments that ignore nothing.

retain_unused_imported_modules.description: Names of imported modules to retain even when unused.

external_encodable_protocols.description: External protocols that inherit Encodable; the properties and CodingKey enums of conforming types are retained.

external_codable_protocols.description: External protocols that inherit Codable; the properties and CodingKey enums of conforming types are retained.

external_test_case_classes.description: XCTestCase subclasses that live in external targets.

disable_update_check.description: Do not check for a new version.

strict.description: Exit with status 1 if any result is reported.

index_store_path.description: Index store paths, relative to the project root; implies skip_build.

skip_schemes_validation.description: Do not check that the schemes exist.

clean_build.description: Remove existing build artifacts before building.

cache_max_age_days.description: Age in days after which unused Xcode build caches are evicted at the end of a scan; 0 disables eviction.

build_arguments.description: Arguments passed to the underlying build tool (swift build or xcodebuild).

xcode_list_arguments.description: Extra arguments for the 'xcodebuild -list' call that lists schemes (guided setup).

relative_results.description: Report paths relative to the project root, or to relative_results_base.

relative_results_base.description: Directory the result paths are relative to when relative_results is in effect (command line: --relative-to).

changed_since.description: Report only the results in files that changed since this git ref: committed since its merge base with HEAD, uncommitted or untracked (command line: --changed-since). The whole project is still analysed.

changed_lines.description: With changed_since, report only the results on changed lines.

json_package_manifest_path.description: Package manifest as JSON (from 'swift package describe --type json', or written by hand).

retain_codable_properties.description: Retain properties on Codable types (including Encodable and Decodable).

retain_encodable_properties.description: Retain properties on Encodable types only.

retain_equatable_properties.description: Retain properties on Equatable types, including Hashable types.

baseline.description: Baseline file whose entries are hidden from the results.

write_baseline.description: Write the results to a baseline file, keeping the entries of baseline.

prune_baseline.description: Rewrite the baseline file keeping only the entries that still match a result; requires baseline.

strict_baseline.description: Exit with status 1 if the baseline holds entries that no longer match; requires baseline.

write_results.description: Also write the formatted results to a file.

skip_stdout_results.description: Do not print the results to stdout; requires write_results.

generic_project_config.description: Project configuration file for other build systems.

retain_synthesized_uses.description: Retain stored properties of types whose values are described through reflection (print, dump, String(describing:), interpolation).

retain_attributes.description: Retain declarations that have one of the given attributes (without the @), optionally per declaration kind with '<attribute>:kind1,kind2'.

detect_unused_asset_catalog_colors.description: Find unused colors of Xcode asset catalogs.

detect_unused_asset_catalog_images.description: Find unused images of Xcode asset catalogs.

detect_unused_metal_functions.description: Find Metal functions that no Swift string literal names, and literals naming a Metal function that no .metal file declares.

oneOf.description: A glob, or '<glob>:kind1,kind2' to exclude only the given result kinds.
A glob limited to the given result kinds.
